excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content:
Now that the geth nodes should be back in sync, we are still missing ~30% of nodes. I connected to a few nodes and noticed that it seems like lighthouse is in a state of perpetual syncing, e.g.
```
Aug 14 06:57:54.000 INFO  Syncing                                       peers: "103", distance: "6735 slots (22 hrs 27 mins)", est_time: "--"
```
And thus the geth nodes do not get any up to date FCU's 
see for example `ssh devops@lighthouse-geth-super-1.fusaka-devnet-4.ethpandaops.io` cc <@&595683849225240704>
